sn29.7:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.7:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn29.7:2.1: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī hoti, manasā dvayakārī,
sn29.7:2.5: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn29.7:2.6: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn29.7:2.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
